high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Inc42.com, titled "30 Startups To Watch: Startup Siftly." The article discusses the founding of Siftly (formerly Airdot) by childhood friends Chalam PVS and Sandilya Miduthuri in 2021. The content highlights how Siftly aims to help businesses connect with their company data and obtain insights by asking questions in plain English.
